text: dsh-plugin-vision 是面向 DSH web 客户端的视觉模型插件，注册图片分析、会话图片枚举和 OSS 上传工具，并提供双语设置卡片。它把本地图片、会话附件、图片 URL 或 JSON 图包交给可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，返回文字观察结果；还可把开发机图片经局域网端点或 OSS 中转。适合需要 OCR、图表理解、界面识别或多图比较的 DSH 用户。需配置所选模型供应商的 API 密钥；OSS 中转需另行启用并配置阿里云 OSS。

dsh-plugin-vision adds image analysis to the DSH web client. It sends local or session images to a configurable vision model and supports image listing, OCR, chart reading, and LAN image uploads. Configure a provider API key; OSS relay is optional.

Let my DSH agent inspect screenshots with a vision model.
I need OCR and visual analysis for images in a conversation.
dsh-plugin-vision 的功能「图片问答」：vision_analyze 将一张或多张图片及 agent 编写的观察指令提交给视觉模型并返回文字结果；可指定系统提示、模型、细节档位和输出长度。
dsh-plugin-vision 的功能「会话图片查找」：vision_list_images 列出会话中的图片附件及摘要，让 agent 用摘要或 latest 选择图片交给分析工具。
dsh-plugin-vision 的功能「开发机推图」：局域网设备可向 DSH web 接收端点上传图片，插件保存后给出摘要，供后续视觉分析使用。
dsh-plugin-vision 的功能「多供应商视觉模型」：设置卡片可配置 OpenAI 兼容模型的供应商、模型和能力，勾选能力会动态加入 agent 系统提示。
dsh-plugin-vision 的功能「OSS 图片中转」：启用 OSS 后，工具可生成短时效的预签名上传地址，开发机上传后再通过对象键分析图片。
dsh-plugin-vision 使用前须知：分析图片会将图像交给所选视觉模型服务；需设置对应服务的 API 密钥，密钥通过配置读取。 (见 index.js:1010-1040)
dsh-plugin-vision 使用前须知：局域网推图端点由 web 服务挂载并使用本机令牌；图片内容会存入 DSH 附件存储，inbox 元数据按配置过期清理。 (见 index.js:907-925)

dsh-plugin-vision README · dsh-plugin-vision：**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Give a DSH agent a pair of eyes.

When the main model is text-only, an image in the conversation is just a line saying
`[image omitted because this model accepts text only; attachment sha256:1a2b3c4d]`.
This plugin closes that gap: the agent writes its own observation prompt, hands the image to an
online vision model (VLM), and gets a written answer back.

dsh-plugin-vision README · dsh-plugin-vision：- **Many providers** — every call is the OpenAI-compatible `POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions`.
  Eleven presets ship in the box, and any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint works too.
- **Checked capabilities become prompt text** — tick what this model is good at (grounding / OCR /
  documents & charts / video / GUI / deep thinking / multi-image …) and those notes are **injected
  into the agent's system prompt in real time**, telling it what else this model can do and how to ask.
- **The prompt belongs to the agent** — the plugin ships no "describe this image" template. What to
  look at, how finely, and in what output shape is written by the agent on the spot.
- **It can see images from the conversation** — whatever the user drops into the input box, the agent
  can name with `latest` or with the eight-hex digest it sees in the placeholder.
- **Keys live in the credential store** — written to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; the UI only ever shows
  *configured* or *not set*, never the literal.
- **Bilingual UI** — the settings card follows DSH's own language preference (中文 / English).

dsh-plugin-vision README · A. Official `dsh plugin add` (recommended)：> ⚠️ **Do not run `dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-vision`.** That bare name resolves to the public npm
> registry, where `dsh-plugin-vision` belongs to an unrelated project by a different author — it is
> not this plugin and will not work with a current DSH. Always install from this repository.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:aijunjiang/dsh-plugin-vision

dsh-plugin-vision README · or from a local checkout: dsh plugin --profile web add <this-repo-path>：```

> The internal `@deepseek-ai` packages ride the DSH baseline as optional peers, so npm pulls nothing;
> the package declaring `dsh.bundle` is auto-registered into the profile's bundles layer.
> Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-vision`.

Restart `dsh web` once after installing so the settings card appears.

dsh-plugin-vision README · B. Local development：Link the repository into the target profile's `node_modules` under its package name, then add one row
to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```powershell

dsh-plugin-vision README · Windows, using the web profile：New-Item -ItemType Junction `
  -Path  "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-plugin-vision" `
  -Target "C:\path\to\dsh-plugin-vision"
```

dsh-plugin-vision README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: vision-bundle
      name: dsh-plugin-vision
      config:
        provider: ark

```

dsh-plugin-vision README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：The web profile is live-reloading: saving the patch file applies **configuration changes** (provider,
model, base URL …) immediately. But **changes to the plugin's own source** (`index.js`, `catalog.js`)
are *not* hot-reloaded — the module stays in the ESM cache, so restart `dsh web` after editing it.
**The settings card is the browser half: refresh the page once; if it still does not appear, restart
`dsh web`.**

dsh-plugin-vision README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：> ⚠️ On Windows, never edit that YAML with PowerShell 5.1's `Get-Content` / `Set-Content -Encoding utf8`:
> the first decodes as GBK and destroys non-ASCII comments, the second writes a BOM. Either one makes
> the whole patch layer fail to parse and takes every plugin down with it. Use
> `[System.IO.File]::ReadAllText/WriteAllText($p, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))`.

dsh-plugin-vision README · Configure：| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | Switching resets model, base URL and capabilities to that vendor's defaults |
| Model ID | Empty = the preset. **Vendors rotate model IDs; change it here when one expires** |
| Base URL | Empty = the preset endpoint; point it at a private deployment or proxy |
| API key | Written to the DSH credential store; empty = keep the stored key |
| Capabilities | Checked items are injected into the agent's system prompt |
| *Advanced* → Detail level | `auto` / `high` (better on small text) / `low` (faster, cheaper) |
| *Advanced* → Deep thinking | `unset` / `auto` / `enabled` / `disabled`; honoured only where supported |
| *Advanced* → Max images per call | Default 6 |
| *Advanced* → Timeout (ms) | Default 120000 |
| *Advanced* → Credential reference | The key name in the credential store; an environment variable of the same name also works |

dsh-plugin-vision README · Configure：Key resolution order: **the `apiKey` settings field → the DSH credential domain (whatever `apiKeyEnv`
points at) → an environment variable of that name**.

dsh-plugin-vision README · `vision_analyze`：| Parameter | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `images` | ✅ | Array of image sources |
| `prompt` | ✅ | The observation instruction, **written by the agent** |
| `system` | | A role for the vision model |
| `model` | | Override the model for this call only |
| `detail` | | `auto` / `high` / `low` |
| `thinking` | | `auto` / `enabled` / `disabled` |
| `max_tokens` | | Reply budget for this call |

Each entry of `images` may be:

dsh-plugin-vision README · `vision_analyze`：| Form | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `C:\pic\a.png`, `/home/u/a.jpg` | A local file, read through `ctx.fs` so the sandbox and any remote route still apply; a missing extension is resolved by magic bytes |
| `https://…` | A remote URL, passed straight through for the model to fetch |
| `data:image/png;base64,…` | Inline |
| `json:/path/bundle.json` | **A JSON image bundle**: base64 kept in a file, many images at once — see below |
| `sha256:1a2b3c4d` | A conversation attachment digest — **a prefix is enough**, so the eight hex characters in the text-only placeholder work |
| `latest` / `latest:3` | The most recent 1 / 3 images in this conversation |

dsh-plugin-vision README · `vision_list_images`：No parameters. Lists every image attachment seen in this conversation (name, size, type, digest), **plus
whatever dev machines have pushed into the ingest inbox** (newest first, with push time and expiry), so an
agent staring at `[image omitted …]` still knows which images exist and how to name one.

> ⚠️ Inbox images are **not session events** — `latest` will not reach them. Name them by `sha256` digest.

dsh-plugin-vision README · Pushing images from a dev machine：Dev machines are many, variously configured, and constantly changing. Copying each image onto the host
before analysing it meant redoing the same dance for every new machine. Now the host mounts one HTTP
route: **any dev machine pushes the bytes with a single curl** — nothing to install, no port to open.
section: Pushing images from a dev machine

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · Endpoint contract：| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Path | `/dsh-vision/ingest`, same port as the GUI (3080 by default) |
| Method | `POST` / `PUT`, **body is the raw image bytes** (not a form field, not a base64 string) |
| Auth | `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or `X-Vision-Token: <token>` |
| Naming | `?name=shot.png`, optional, display only |
| Formats | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF / BMP, decided by magic bytes (the `Content-Type` header is not trusted) |

dsh-plugin-vision README · Where the token comes from：Generated on first boot into `~/.dsh/vision-inbox/token` (mode `0600`) and **reused across restarts**, so a
dev machine hardcodes it once.

dsh-plugin-vision README · Where the token comes from：| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `201` | stored |
| `401` | token missing or wrong (identical response for both, to prevent probing) |
| `413` | over the per-request byte cap (32 MB by default) |
| `415` | body is not a supported image |
| `507` | inbox full (200 items by default) — sweep or raise the cap |
| `404` | the endpoint is switched off in settings |

dsh-plugin-vision README · Why the service lives on the host, not the dev machine：Because the thing that needs to *see* the image is the VLM the host talks to (`baseUrl` points at a public
DashScope / Ark endpoint). Put the service on a dev machine and the host still has to pull it. Put it on
the host and each dev machine pushes once. However many dev machines there are, only "who pushes" varies —
"how it is received" stays in one place.
section: Why the service lives on the host, not the dev machine

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · Storage and expiry：- Bytes go through the existing attachment service (`attachments.saveImage`): content-addressed and
  deduplicated — **pushing the same image twice does not cost a second inbox slot**.
- Metadata lives in `~/.dsh/vision-inbox/items/` and expires after **24 hours** by default (swept every
  10 minutes).
- Expiry removes metadata only, **never the attachment object** — a conversation may still reference it.

dsh-plugin-vision README · Related settings：| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ingest endpoint | on | Off makes the path answer 404 |
| Retention (hours) | 24 | `ingestTtlHours` |
| Per-request byte cap | 32 MB | `ingestMaxBytes` |
| Inbox item cap | 200 | `ingestMaxItems`, answers 507 when full |

dsh-plugin-vision README · Related settings：> ⚠️ Port 3080 binds `0.0.0.0` with no platform-level authentication. Token checking, the byte cap and the
> item cap are **all implemented inside this plugin**. Do not paste the token anywhere public; if in doubt,
> switch the endpoint off.

dsh-plugin-vision README · How images should reach the model (in the system prompt, and enforced at runtime)：| Don't | Do | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stand up a local/LAN image server and hand `http://192.168.1.7/a.png` to an online model | Put the local path straight into `images` | **The VLM runs on the public internet and cannot reach your intranet.** The plugin rejects private hosts before the request goes out (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `10.x`, `192.168.x`, `172.16–31.x`, `169.254.x`, `*.local`) and tells the agent what to do instead |
| Pass a path that lives on a remote device | Fetch it locally first, then pass the local path | A remote host's local path is just as unreachable for a public model |
| `read` the image yourself, base64 it, and pass a data URL | Pass the path, or name it with a `sha256:` digest / `latest` | Those bytes land **in full inside the agent's context** — context spent and tokens burned; the plugin reading the same image costs the agent nothing. If a large data URL (≥20000 chars) is passed anyway, the tool result ends with a note telling the agent to switch |
section: How images should reach the model (in the system prompt, and enforced at runtime)

text: dsh-plugin-vision README · How images should reach the model (in the system prompt, and enforced at runtime)：> Exception: when `baseUrl` itself points at a local model (Ollama / vLLM), the model and the image share one network, so private addresses are legitimate and are not blocked.

JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64：```
images: ["json:/tmp/bundle.json"]        the whole bundle
images: ["json:/tmp/bundle.json#2"]      only the 2nd image
images: ["json:/tmp/bundle.json#2-4"]    images 2 through 4
```

**What it saves** — measured on three 200×150 PNGs:

| | Characters | ≈ tokens |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Inlined as data URLs in `images` | 297,373 | ~74,000 |
| `json:/tmp/bundle.json` | **75** | **~20** |

The model receives **exactly the same images**; what disappears is the copy in the agent's context.
section: JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64

text: dsh-plugin-vision README · JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64：The parser is **deliberately liberal** (Postel's law) — all of these are accepted:
section: JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64：| Where | Accepted |
| --- | --- |
| Top level | `{"images":[…]}`, `{"items"/"list"/"data"/"frames":[…]}`, a bare array, or a single object for one image |
| Entry | An object, or **a bare base64 string** |
| Image field | `data` / `base64` / `b64` / `content` / `bytes` / `image` / `dataUrl`; the value may carry a `data:image/...;base64,` prefix, contain newlines, or be URL-safe base64 |
| Alternative source | `path` (a relative path resolves against **the JSON file's own directory**) or `url` (still subject to the private-address block) |
| Media type | `mediaType` / `mime` / `type` … may be **omitted entirely** — the plugin sniffs the magic bytes; a wrong declaration loses to the sniff and is flagged in the label |
| Name | `name` / `label` / `title` / `id` …, carried into the image label so the prompt can refer to "image 2" |
section: JSON image bundles: the right way when all you have is base64

dsh-plugin-vision README · Remote box: bundle every PNG in the current directory：Limits: each image still obeys the **per-image byte cap**, the expanded total still obeys **max images per
call**, the whole file is capped at 128 MB, and a bundle may not reference another bundle.

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · Coordinate discipline：For anything positional, pin the output shape in the prompt **and make the model report the pixel size
of the image it actually processed** — otherwise the coordinates cannot be mapped back:

```
Output JSON only: [{"label":"...","bbox_2d":[x1,y1,x2,y2]}]
Before the JSON, state on one line the pixel width and height of the image you processed,
and whether the coordinates are absolute pixels or normalized.
```

dsh-plugin-vision README · Coordinate discipline：Vendors disagree here (known: Qwen-VL returns `bbox_2d` in **absolute pixels of the processed image**;
GLM-V returns **0–1000 normalized** values wrapped in `<|begin_of_box|> … <|end_of_box|>`), so *asking
the model to state its own basis* beats assuming one.

dsh-plugin-vision README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause / fix |
| --- | --- |
| `未配置视觉模型 API Key` | Save a key in the card, or export the environment variable named by `apiKeyEnv` |
| `HTTP 401 AuthenticationError` | A key was found but the endpoint rejects it — note that a *search* API key and a *model* API key are usually different things |
| `HTTP 404 / model not found` | The model ID expired or the account lacks access; pick another in the card |
| Only thinking content, no answer | A thinking model spent the whole budget on reasoning; raise `max_tokens` or set `thinking` to `disabled` |
| `按摘要 xxx 没找到附件对象` | Call `vision_list_images` first; images from another conversation are not in this one's events |
| `字节不是受支持的图片格式` | Only PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF / BMP are accepted |
| The card never appears | The browser half needs one page refresh; if that fails, restart `dsh web` |
| Every plugin disappears at once | The profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is probably corrupted (BOM / encoding) — see the warning above |

dsh-plugin-vision README · Development：```bash
npm run sync    # regenerate the CATALOG mirror inside client.js from catalog.js
npm test        # host logic + execute path + offline card rendering (no browser)
npm run check   # syntax check + mirror-is-in-sync check + the full test suite
```

dsh-plugin-vision README · Development：- `catalog.js` — providers and capabilities, **the single source of truth**. Adding a provider means
  editing this file and running `npm run sync`.
- `index.js` — the host half: two tools, the settings namespace, key resolution, image resolution,
  the live system-prompt section, and the mount point for the ingest endpoint.
- `ingest.js` — the LAN ingest endpoint: token, byte and item caps, content-addressed storage, TTL sweep.
  Self-contained; the only DSH dependency (`attachments`) is read optionally.
- `client.js` — the browser half: the settings card and its `zh` / `en` dictionaries. A client bundle
  may not `import`, so the catalog is mirrored in by generation rather than imported.
- `tests/session-images.test.mjs` — conversation image enumeration (the ground `latest` and digests
  stand on): all five event shapes the host's session controller walks (`data.content`,
  `data.message.content`, `data.inserted[]`, the `block-end` of `assistant/chunk`, and nested
  `tool-result`), plus de-duplication, ordering, hostile data, config normalization and prompt injection.
- `tests/execute.test.mjs` — stands up a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint

dsh-plugin-vision README · Development：`ingest.test.mjs` needs only `node:*`, so it **always runs**; the other three skip cleanly (exit 0) when
their dependencies are absent: `index.js` needs `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, and the card test needs
`react` / `react-dom` (injected by the DSH platform in the browser; locally they resolve from the DSH
profile's `node_modules`).

dsh-plugin-vision README · dsh-plugin-vision：[English](./README.md) · **简体中文**

给 DSH 的 agent 装一双眼睛。

主模型是纯文本的时候，会话里的图片对它来说只是一行
`[image omitted because this model accepts text only; attachment sha256:1a2b3c4d]`。
这个插件把那道缺口补上：agent 自己写观察指令，把图片交给在线视觉大模型（VLM）去看，拿回文字结论。

dsh-plugin-vision README · dsh-plugin-vision：- **多供应商**：统一按 OpenAI 兼容的 `POST {baseUrl}/chat/completions` 调用，内置 11 家预设，
  也可填任意自定义 endpoint。
- **能力勾选即提示词**：在设置卡片里勾选该模型的特色能力（检测框 / OCR / 文档图表 / 视频 / GUI /
  深度思考 / 多图对比…），这些说明会**实时注入 agent 的系统提示**，告诉它「这台模型还能干什么、
  该怎么提要求」。
- **提示词归 agent**：插件不预置「请描述这张图片」之类的模板。观察什么、要多细、输出什么格式，
  由 agent 现场撰写。
- **看得见会话里的图**：用户在输入框上传的图片，agent 可以直接用 `latest` 或占位符里那串 8 位摘要点名分析。
- **开发机直接推图**：宿主机挂一条接收端点，局域网里任意开发机用一条 `curl` 把图片推上来即可，
  **不需要安装任何东西、不需要开放端口**，也不用再把图先拷到宿主机磁盘。
- **密钥进凭据库**：API Key 存在 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`，界面只显示「已配置 / 未配置」，永不回显字面量。

section: 宿主机地址就是你打开 GUI 的那个地址；令牌见「设置 → 插件 → 视觉能力 → 推图端点」

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · 端点约定：| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 路径 | `/dsh-vision/ingest`，与 GUI 同端口（默认 3080） |
| 方法 | `POST` / `PUT`，**请求体就是原始图片字节**（不是表单，不是 base64 字符串） |
| 认证 | `Authorization: Bearer <token>`，也接受 `X-Vision-Token: <token>` |
| 命名 | `?name=xxx.png` 可选，只作显示用 |
| 支持格式 | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF / BMP（按魔数判定，不信任 `Content-Type`） |

dsh-plugin-vision README · 令牌从哪来：首次启动时自动生成，保存在 `~/.dsh/vision-inbox/token`（权限 `0600`），
**重启后复用同一个**，所以开发机上的脚本写死一次就行。

| 状态码 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `201` | 入库成功 |
| `401` | 令牌缺失或错误（两者响应一致，避免探测） |
| `413` | 超过单次体积上限（默认 32 MB） |
| `415` | 请求体不是受支持的图片 |
| `507` | inbox 已满（默认 200 条），先清理或调大上限 |
| `404` | 端点在设置里被关闭了 |

dsh-plugin-vision README · 为什么服务在宿主机、而不是开发机：因为**真正需要「看见」图片的是宿主机上的视觉模型**（`baseUrl` 指向公网 DashScope / 方舟）。
把服务放开发机上，宿主机仍然得去拉；放宿主机上，开发机只需推一次。
开发机数量再多、环境再杂，都只影响「谁推」，「怎么收」只有一处。
section: 为什么服务在宿主机、而不是开发机

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · 存储与过期：- 字节走 DSH 现有的附件服务（`attachments.saveImage`），内容寻址、自动去重——
  **同一张图重复推送不会多占一条**。
- 元数据存在 `~/.dsh/vision-inbox/items/`，默认 **24 小时**后由后台清理（每 10 分钟扫一次）。
- 清理只删元数据，**不删附件对象**——避免删掉会话里还在引用的图。

dsh-plugin-vision README · 相关设置：| 设置项 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 推图端点 | 开 | 关掉后该路径返回 404 |
| 保留时长（小时） | 24 | `ingestTtlHours` |
| 单次体积上限 | 32 MB | `ingestMaxBytes` |
| inbox 条目上限 | 200 | `ingestMaxItems`，满了返回 507 |

> ⚠️ 3080 默认绑 `0.0.0.0` 且平台层没有鉴权。这个端点的令牌校验、体积上限、条目上限
> **全部由插件自己实现**，不要把令牌贴到公开的地方；不确定时把「推图端点」关掉即可。

dsh-plugin-vision README · 传图纪律（已写进 agent 的系统提示，并在运行时强制）：| 别这么干 | 该这么干 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 起个本地/局域网图片服务，把 `http://192.168.1.7/a.png` 交给在线模型 | 直接把本地路径写进 `images` | **在线 VLM 在公网，它回不到你的内网**。插件会在发请求前拦下私有地址（`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `10.x` / `192.168.x` / `172.16–31.x` / `169.254.x` / `*.local`）并告诉 agent 怎么改 |
| 把远端设备上的路径直接丢给模型 | 先取回本地，再传本地路径 | 远端主机的本地路径对公网模型同样不可达 |
| 自己 `read` 出 base64 拼成 data URL 传进来 | 传路径，或用 `sha256:` 摘要 / `latest` 点名 | 那串字节会**完整落进 agent 的上下文**，既挤占上下文又白花 token；插件读同一张图不占 agent 一个 token。真塞了大段 base64（≥20000 字符）时，工具会在结果末尾提醒它下次换传法 |

dsh-plugin-vision README · JSON 图包：手里只有 base64 时的正道：有时确实拿不到文件——远端 API 返回的、数据库字段里的、脚本现算的。这时**不要让 agent 把 base64 打印出来**，
而是在产生它的那一侧写成 JSON 文件，agent 只传一行路径：

```json
{
  "images": [
    { "name": "首帧", "data": "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUg..." },
    { "name": "尾帧", "data": "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUg..." }

```
images: ["json:/tmp/bundle.json"]        整包
images: ["json:/tmp/bundle.json#2"]      只要第 2 张
images: ["json:/tmp/bundle.json#2-4"]    第 2 到第 4 张
```

**省了多少**：实测 3 张 200×150 的 PNG，
section: JSON 图包：手里只有 base64 时的正道

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · JSON 图包：手里只有 base64 时的正道：| | 字符数 | 约合 token |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 拼成 data URL 走 `images` | 297,373 | ~74,000 |
| `json:/tmp/bundle.json` | **75** | **~20** |

模型收到的图**一模一样**，省掉的是 agent 上下文里那份副本。

解析器**刻意写得宽松**（Postel 原则），下面这些生产方写法都认：
section: JSON 图包：手里只有 base64 时的正道

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · JSON 图包：手里只有 base64 时的正道：| 位置 | 接受的写法 |
| --- | --- |
| 顶层 | `{"images":[…]}`、`{"items"/"list"/"data"/"frames":[…]}`、顶层直接是数组、单张时直接一个对象 |
| 条目 | 对象，或**直接一串 base64 字符串** |
| 图片字段 | `data` / `base64` / `b64` / `content` / `bytes` / `image` / `dataUrl`；值可带 `data:image/...;base64,` 前缀、可带换行、可是 URL-safe base64 |
| 替代来源 | `path`（相对路径按 **JSON 文件所在目录**解析）或 `url`（同样受私有地址拦截约束） |
| 类型 | `mediaType` / `mime` / `type` 等**可以完全省略**——插件按字节魔数嗅探；声明错了以嗅探为准，并在标签里标注 |
| 名字 | `name` / `label` / `title` / `id` 等，会写进图片标签，方便在 prompt 里用「第 2 张」指代 |

section: JSON 图包：手里只有 base64 时的正道

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · 远端：把当前目录若干 PNG 打成图包：python3 -c "
import base64, glob, json
print(json.dumps({'images':[{'name':p,'data':base64.b64encode(open(p,'rb').read()).decode()} for p in sorted(glob.glob('*.png'))]}))
" > bundle.json
```

```js
// Node：把内存里的 Buffer 直接落盘成图包
fs.writeFileSync('bundle.json', JSON.stringify({
  images: buffers.map((b, i) => ({ name: `frame-${i}`, data: b.toString('base64') })),
}))
```

约束：单图仍受**单图字节上限**约束，展开后的总张数仍受**单次最多图片数**约束，整包读取上限 128MB；
图包里不能再引用另一个图包（禁止套娃）。
section: 远端：把当前目录若干 PNG 打成图包

text:
dsh-plugin-vision README · 坐标纪律：任何涉及位置的问题，都要在 prompt 里**写死输出格式并要求模型回报它处理的图像宽高**，否则坐标无法还原：

```
只输出 JSON：[{"label":"...","bbox_2d":[x1,y1,x2,y2]}]
并在 JSON 前用一行说明你处理的图像像素宽高，以及坐标是绝对像素还是归一化值。
```

各家约定并不一致（已知：Qwen-VL 返回处理后图像的**绝对像素** `bbox_2d`；GLM-V 返回 **0–1000 归一化**
且包在 `<|begin_of_box|> … <|end_of_box|>` 里），所以「让模型自报基准」比「假设某种基准」可靠。

dsh-plugin-vision README · 排错：| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| `未配置视觉模型 API Key` | 卡片里保存密钥，或 export `apiKeyEnv` 指定的环境变量 |
| `HTTP 401 AuthenticationError` | 密钥取到了但不被该 endpoint 认可——注意「搜索 API 密钥」和「模型 API 密钥」通常不是同一把 |
| `HTTP 404 / model not found` | 模型 ID 过期或该账号无权限，在卡片里换一个 |
| 只有思考内容、没有正文 | 思考型模型把 token 全花在推理上了：调大 `max_tokens`，或把 `thinking` 设为 `disabled` |
| `按摘要 xxx 没找到附件对象` | 先调 `vision_list_images` 确认摘要；跨会话的图不在当前会话事件里 |
| `字节不是受支持的图片格式` | 只支持 PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF / BMP |
| 卡片不出现 | 客户端半需要刷新页面；仍无则重启 `dsh web` |
| 所有插件一起消失 | 多半是 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 被写坏（BOM / 编码），见上文警告 |

dsh-plugin-vision README · 开发：```bash
npm run sync    # 用 catalog.js 重新生成 client.js 里的 CATALOG 镜像
npm test        # 宿主逻辑 + 执行路径 + 卡片离线渲染（不开浏览器）
npm run check   # 语法检查 + 校验镜像同步 + 跑全部测试
```

dsh-plugin-vision README · 开发：- `catalog.js` —— 供应商与能力清单，**唯一真相源**。加一家供应商只改这里，然后 `npm run sync`。
- `index.js` —— 宿主半：两个工具、配置命名空间、密钥解析、图片解析、动态系统提示段落，以及接收端点的挂载点。
- `ingest.js` —— 局域网接收端点：令牌、体积/条目上限、内容寻址入库、TTL 清理。自我封闭，不依赖 DSH 服务（`attachments` 走可选读取）。
- `client.js` —— 客户端半：设置卡片与它的 `zh` / `en` 词典。客户端 bundle 不允许 import，
  故 CATALOG 以生成的方式内联。
- `tests/session-images.test.mjs` —— 会话图片枚举（`latest` / 摘要点名的地基）：覆盖宿主
  session-controller 走的全部五条事件路径（`data.content`、`data.message.content`、`data.inserted[]`、
  `assistant/chunk` 的 `block-end`、嵌套 `tool-result`），外加去重、顺序、脏数据与配置归一化、提示词注入。
- `tests/execute.test.mjs` —— 起一个本地 OpenAI 兼容假端点，把 `execute()` 完整跑通：断言请求体
  （鉴权头、各家 detail/thinking 映射、多图标注、extraBody 合并）与全部响应/错误分支
  （分片 content、思考截断、只有思考没有正文、模型拒答、HTTP 500、非 JSON、缺 Key、张数超限、中止）。
- `tests/client-card.test.cjs` —— 用 `react-dom/server` 把卡片渲染成静态 HTML，断言官方卡片结构、
  中英两种语言、`zh`/`en` 键集对齐、高级选项默认收起，以及保存设置与写凭据的调用序列。
- `tests/ingest.test.mjs` —— 接收端点：真起一个 http server 用真请求打，覆盖令牌校验（缺失/错误
  响应一致）、方法、格式、体积上限、条目上限、内容寻址去重、TTL 清理、坏文件容错、令牌持久化。

dsh-plugin-vision README · 开发：`ingest.test.mjs` 只依赖 `node:*`，不需要 DSH 的 `node_modules`，因此**永远会跑**；
另外两个会在依赖缺失时自动跳过（退出码 0）：`index.js` 需要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，
卡片测试需要 `react` / `react-dom`（浏览器端由 DSH 平台注入，本地可从 DSH profile 的
`node_modules` 解析）。
